children.name: Tovaria diffusa  Fawc. & Rendle
children.description: One of two species of the herb genus Tovaria (family Tovariaceae, order Brassicales), which comprises soft, malodorous annual to short-lived herbs with flowers typically 6-8-merous and a berry fruit. It was described from Jamaica (Flora of Jamaica, 1914); the genus ranges from Mexico and the Greater Antilles through montane Central and South America.

children.name: Tovaria pendula Ruiz & Pav.
children.description: Andes, Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
